verdict.rationale: The docs show Semgrep runs as a CI job across supported providers, triggered on push events and pull/merge requests, using the `semgrep ci` command with findings sent to the AppSec Platform. The pack never mentions exit codes, build-failing behavior, or diff-aware scanning that limits results to new findings, so the build-gating half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented non-zero exit codes on findings, build failure/blocking configuration, diff-aware scanning of only new findings on PRs, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI gating.
